name: Apify API
summary: Run web scraping actors to extract business listings, websites, and directory data.
whatItDoes: Orchestrates pre-built scrapers (Actors) for Google Maps, Yelp, LinkedIn, and custom sites — feeds lead discovery and account research workflows with structured JSON output.
actionsSupported: Run Actors on schedule or demand
privacyNotes: Scraping third-party sites may violate their terms of service. Use only for publicly available data and respect robots.txt where applicable.
